# TheQueensDeadBruh

> TheQueensDeadBruh is automatically removes mistlands atmospheric mist from the world once the queen boss is defeated. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **Global key state monitoring and Mistlands particle suppression**: Global key state monitoring and Mistlands particle suppression.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal world-state watchers**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal world-state watchers.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/TheQueensDeadBruh/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
